{{Quote|Bring senator Amidala before me!''"<br />"''Uh, she caused a great deal of damage to our droids and she escaped, sir.|Nute Gunray and this droid|<ref name="Bombad Jedi">{{TCW|Bombad Jedi}}</ref>}}
A '''[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]''' was stationed in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the subsequent [[Mission to Rodia/Legends|apprehension]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and served under command of [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].

==History==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], this [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] along with a squad of droids accompanied [[Viceroy/Legends|viceroy]] Nute Gunray to the planet of Rodia on his [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]], the [[Lapiz Cutter/Legends|Lapiz Cutter]]. After they arrived on the planet, this droid went to the detention tower to check on the captor senator, but discovered that she had escaped and taken out her droid guards, and reported the incident to Gunray. This droid was later destroyed along with the rest of the battle droid squad by senator Amidala.
